tui.transcript_fold.turn.note: The name column of the bar that folds a whole settled turn down to its answer (By turn). Lower case, one word: it sits in the ledger's shared name column beside rows like `bash`.

tui.transcript_fold.work.note: The name column of the bar that folds a run of three or more back-to-back tool calls. Lower case, one word; it names the WORK, not any one tool, because the summary beside it lists the tools.

tui.transcript_fold.failed.note: The failure tally on a fold bar: how many of the calls the bar hides failed. `{label}` is the rendered count (raw decimal in English, format_number elsewhere); the cross is part of the value and must stay, because colour is never the only carrier. Reads at a glance on one row.

tui.transcript_fold.times.note: How many consecutive calls of ONE tool a same-tool sub-bar covers, e.g. `×16`. `{label}` is the rendered count; the multiplication sign is part of the value and must stay. Never a sentence.
